6x6x6 or 9x6x6 boxes for small items and some small fragile items. The more fragile the item, the higher the handling cost.

$12.99 – $25.99 | Medium Boxes

Description

Featuring a vibrant assortment of round cardboard POGs and several metal and plastic slammers, this lot showcases a colorful variety of fun designs, including cartoons, sports, holographic graphics, and bold patterns. Each piece is individually unique, capturing the energetic spirit of the 1990s playground craze. This collection contains a substantial number of caps and slammers, making it ideal for collectors, hobbyists, or anyone looking to relive classic game moments. The POGs and slammers exhibit evidence of regular handling, with some edge wear and minor surface scratches visible on certain pieces, which is typical for vintage game pieces played and enjoyed over the years. No original branding or manufacture year is shown, emphasizing a truly mixed assortment. Both storage tubes are included for convenient organization and display. A fantastic find for anyone wanting to expand their collection or introduce new players to this iconic game

description:
Petrified Wood and Agate Specimen Lot
Mineral Specimen Lot - 2 Pieces
Polished and Natural, Brown and Tan, Vintage
This mineral collector's lot features two distinct geological specimens showcasing the beauty of silicified minerals. The first is a rectangular block of polished banded stone, possibly jasper or agatized petrified wood, featuring rhythmic wavy bands of sienna, tan, and cream with a translucent agate corner. The second is a natural rough specimen of petrified wood showing dark internal wood-grain patterns and a characteristic stone-hard fossilized texture.
Polished block displays intricate wavy banding and a translucent agate section at one end
Rough specimen exhibits dark carbon-rich fossilized wood grain and bark-like outer texture
Heavy stone-hard composition consistent with silica-replaced fossilized material
Polished block measures approximately 7 inches in length; total lot weight 2 pounds
Condition:
The polished block shows minor surface scratches and a small chip along one edge consistent with vintage display. The rough specimen remains in its natural state with jagged edges and exposed fossilized grain. No significant structural cracks observed. Finish on the block remains glossy despite light wear.

These minerals are typically appreciated for their aesthetic beauty and the calming presence they lend to any space. Suitable for collectors, crystal enthusiasts, or anyone seeking to add an attractive mineral accent to their home or office.

Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

description:
Product Overview:
This lot contains a variety of rocks, minerals, and fossils including a multicolored stone marked 'Lee Spiller', a white quartz or calcite geode, clear quartz crystal, agate geodes, chalcedony, quartz clusters, an ammonite fossil, and a trilobite fossil.

Specifications:
- Multicolored stone with inscription
- White geode composed of quartz or calcite
- Clear quartz crystal specimen
- Small mineral specimens including agate geodes, chalcedony, and quartz clusters
- Fossils include ammonite and trilobite
- Natural rough edges and matrix present on some pieces

Additional Information:
The specimens vary in size and form a diverse collection of geological and paleontological samples.
